statement: California final wages, including accrued vacation, are due immediately at termination when the employer discharges the employee (Labor Code § 201), within 72 hours when the employee quits without notice, or at the time of quitting when the employee gave at least 72 hours notice (Labor Code § 202); a willful failure accrues a waiting-time penalty of a day's wages per day late, up to 30 calendar days (Labor Code § 203).
caveat: Special timing rules apply to some industries and to commissions and bonuses not yet calculable at termination. This repo does not compute final pay or penalties.
